xmldoc.short_description: Segment an image from an initial contour mask.

param_input_item.param_description: Finite real 2-D grayscale, RGB, or RGBA image. Color images are converted to luminance before segmentation.
Initial 2-D contour mask. Numeric masks are converted to logical values.
Nonnegative integer number of evolution iterations. The default value is 100.

param_output_item.param_description: Logical mask of the segmented region.

description.p: Segment a finite real 2-D image by evolving a binary initial mask. RGB and RGBA images are converted to luminance, and the alpha channel is ignored. The default method is chan-vese. The edge method uses the same region model with edge-weighted smoothing.

The supported name-value options are Iterations, Method, SmoothFactor, a nonnegative finite scalar, and ContractionBias, a finite scalar in the range [-1, 1]. The default values are 100, chan-vese, 1 and 0.

example_item.example_item_description: Segment a bright disk from a small initial mask
Use edge mode with explicit smoothing
